entries: Oh no. You are not getting out of this that easily.
哦不。你可不会这么轻易脱身。
That is all you have to say?
Ok... maybe you are getting out of it that easily.
好吧……也许你还真就这么脱身了。
As soon as we figure it out we will let you know.
等我们弄明白，就告诉你。
Is anyone going to tell me what is going on?
有人打算告诉我这是怎么回事吗？
I am sure it will all make sense eventually.
我相信，这一切终会讲得通。
